title: Young Girl in Plaid Shirt in 1950s Backyard, Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-century portrait of a young girl standing on a grassy backyard lawn beside round garden stepping stones. She is styled in quintessential 1950s youth fashion, wearing a plaid short-sleeve button-down shirt, dark capri-length pedal pushers, and white saddle shoes with socks. Behind her stands a clapboard-sided garage or shed, a wooden fence topped with a potted plant, and a vintage metal spring-base lawn chair under bright summer sunlight.
